maintenance.history_policy: full-market OHLCV is bounded to 180 completed sessions per stock; weekly refresh may fetch ~252 sessions only to rebuild compact 52-week summary and then discards those extra rows

stages.failure_policy: do_not_silently_drop_missing_or_unmapped_codes; pass them into every T2 chain as unknown candidates

T2 recall may remain broad, but only representative companies that passed company-level earnings transmission may enter the common pool. Weekly deep-review names carrying a T2 tag receive priority inside the same cap, not an exemption; weekly-only names without an active T2 tag remain independently eligible.

stages.data_policy: read local bounded 180-session history; use last 120 sessions as core structure window and compact fresh 52-week summary for older pressure; do not make per-candidate live 300-day fetches

recall_principle: LLM classifies mechanically enumerated industries and companies; it does not recall the research universe from memory
representative_selection_principle: T2 is a broad industry/subchain recall, not a license to send every exposed company downstream. After company-level earnings validation, each T2 subchain is compressed to a small set of representatives under a global multi-tag cap. Representative ranking balances absolute profit scale with current earnings transmission so low-base growth does not crowd out established representatives. Weekly deep-review evidence has priority within a tagged T2 chain but remains subject to the same cap; only weekly discoveries without an active T2 tag remain independently eligible. Deferred peers stay auditable in broad recall but do not enter the formal common pool.
valuation_principle: Every non-cycle candidate must map to a versioned PE/PB/other valuation policy; unsupported_policy=0 is a hard gate. Financial PB-ROE uses reported BVPS from financial statements rather than requiring a fragile real-time PB feed. Resource cycle valuation must use current+next-year earnings, a reviewed 6-18m cycle regime and fresh commodity/cost anchors. Peak earnings and short-term commodity strength cannot be capitalized alone.
right_structure_principle: Broad market structure and final candidate structure share one bounded local data store. Keep 180 full sessions per stock, derive 5/20/60 breadth views from it, use 120 sessions as the core candidate structure window, and retain only compact 52-week summary fields beyond 180 sessions. History storage rolls forward daily and never grows without bound.
selection_principle: final selection only selects validated upstream outputs; it never repairs upstream calculations
